clues.question: This 1939 film, based on an L. Frank Baum novel, transitions from sepia to Technicolor once its heroine reaches a magical land.
This 1941 Orson Welles film, often cited as the greatest film ever made, follows the life of a fictional newspaper tycoon.
This 1942 romantic drama set in Morocco during World War II stars Humphrey Bogart and Ingrid Bergman.
